findings.message: The CRD aiservices.hub.traefik.io under crds/ changed (spec.anthropic.token required, spec.anthropic.token type, spec.azureOpenai.apiKey removed, spec.azureOpenai.apiKey type, spec.cohere.token required, spec.cohere.token type, spec.deepSeek.token required, spec.deepSeek.token type, spec.gemini.apiKey required, spec.gemini.apiKey type, spec.mistral.apiKey required, spec.mistral.apiKey type, spec.openai.token required, spec.openai.token type, spec.qWen.token required, spec.qWen.token type). Plain Helm does not upgrade CRDs in that directory. helm upgrade leaves the CRD already in the cluster as it is, and CRDs are not installed on upgrade or rollback.
The pod template of Deployment/stageproof-check/stageproof-rel-traefik changed at spec.template.metadata.labels.helm.sh/chart. The pods will restart. A restart is normal for an upgrade.

findings.detail: 1-line fixes -> Argo CD: `syncOptions: [ServerSideApply=true]` | Flux: `install/upgrade.crds: CreateReplace` | Helm v4: `helm upgrade --server-side` | kubectl: `kubectl apply --server-side -f crds/` (pass `--server-side-apply` if already enabled).
